data.exact_reserve_text:
The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a surplus for 2014 (2013: surplus) as detailed below:
Prior period reserve releases amounted to GBP 103.7 million (2013: GBP 29.8 million) due primarily to improvements within aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance lines. There was also a significant prior year reserve release relating to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 recorded a substantial prior-year reserve release in 2014: a gross prior-year release of GBP 103.7m (approximately 9.4% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,100.7m). The movement is reported as a surplus and is attributed primarily to favourable developments across aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance, together with generally benign catastrophe experience in the year and a notable release related to the World Trade Centre (September 2001) losses.
raw_causal_phrases: The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a surplus for 2014 (2013: surplus) as detailed below:
Prior period reserve releases amounted to GBP 103.7 million (2013: GBP 29.8 million) due primarily to improvements within aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance lines.
As a result of relatively benign catastrophe experience, Syndicate 2488's natural catastrophe related losses after reinsurance recoveries amounted to GBP 5.0 million (2013: GBP 6.4 million).
There was also a significant prior year reserve release relating to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (Liabilities: Technical provisions) 2013 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (shows GBP 103,741k total) and interpreted as a gross prior-year surplus (release). The movement table appears to present gross amounts by regulatory class; if these figures were net of reinsurance the sign/conclusion would change, but the note's wording and table layout indicate gross class movements. 'Marine, aviation and transport' movement was mapped to the single standard LOB 'Marine' (the statutory class bundles aviation and marine together; split not provided) - this mapping is approximate. No claims development (triangle) was found in the provided pages, so no cross-check via triangle was possible.
